name: build-manager help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:build-manager. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Show builds as a chat log
entries.text: An expanded build reads like the Chat viewer: what Brett said, the brief, then each step. Off shows the classic layout, where steps can be ticked.

entries.title: Chat log
entries.text: Shows this build as a conversation: Brett's words, the brief, then each step as it was done.

entries.title: Classic view
entries.text: Shows the classic layout: what was said, the facts and the steps as lists.
